description: namu.wiki describes the outdoor park as holding a transport aircraft that flew troop; ammunition and airborne-drop missions in the 1950s; no type is named. OSM mapped three separate aircraft nodes here (11347270229; 11347270230; 11347270231) and this is the first of the three
